hidden-valley-lake-ca.name: Hidden Valley Lake
hidden-valley-lake-ca.stocking_pattern: MAIN LAKE: trout planted annually Feb/March by HVLA (~$8-10.5k, Smith's Trout Farm) — bass spawn self-sustains, trout added for variety (HVLA board packets). SPILLWAY POND: ~300 trout each spring for the kids' derby. Not CDFW — no rows in the state planting feed, by design. When a plant happens, log it: stocking: [{date, species: rainbow trout}] — then the report lights up the stocker-forage window.
hidden-valley-lake-ca.coords_source: OSM water-body point (Nominatim 2026-09-30); was the community point ~250 m off
